notes.hook: The paradoxical opening creates immediate curiosity about how a mountain can be 'invisible'.
notes.clarity: The explanation of the horizon distance makes the scale of the volcano very easy to grasp.
notes.payoff: The revelation that the horizon is only three kilometers away is a perfect 'mind-bending' fact.
notes.visuals: Several frames use confusing stock imagery or contain visible watermarks.
notes.loop: The repetition of the hook at the end creates a perfectly circular narrative.

frames.problem: The frame shows wind-blown sand dunes which are unrelated to the specific 5 percent slope of a rocky Martian shield volcano.
Contains a visible credit watermark in the bottom left corner.

rounds.better_than_last: The narrative hook is much stronger and more focused than the technical history presented in the Soviet Moon Photos episode.
